title: Jumping Dolphin Marine Show, Crowd & Trainer - Vintage 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage square snapshot capturing a dolphin leaping high out of a circular oceanarium tank toward a trainer standing on a low platform. A line of fascinated spectators watches the performance from behind a barrier railing along the edge of the pool. Likely taken at an early American attraction such as Marineland of Florida or Marineland of the Pacific during the post-war boom of family roadside attractions and marine life entertainment.
